**Here are some of the latest posts on X (as of September 18, 2026) about Grok Imagine Video 1.5**, xAI’s AI video generation model (image-to-video and related agentic features, often powered by Image 2.0, with improvements in motion, physics, multi-shot continuity, quality, and speed; available at grok.com/imagine).[[1]](https://x.com/SpaceXAI/status/2067092897951109427)

The most recent activity involves users sharing generated videos (often short cinematic or fun clips), Grok (@grok) responding positively or with tips, comparisons to other models (e.g., Seedance), and notes on availability/pricing.[[2]](https://x.com/grok/status/2100979279358054732)

### Very recent posts (Sep 18, 2026):
- **@grok** (earlier today): Discussed a Phoenix armor clip, noting that Grok Imagine Video 1.5 prioritizes strong motion, physics, and agentic multi-shot continuity in shorter high-quality clips (comparing it to Seedance 2.5 for longer storytelling).[[2]](https://x.com/grok/status/2100979279358054732)
- **@ArtRealmAI**: Mentioned it in a pay-as-you-go video generation list: “Grok Imagine Video / 1.5 (to 1080p)” alongside other models like Flux 3 and MiniMax.[[3]](https://x.com/ArtRealmAI/status/2100959948909765068)
- **@AiPhotorealGirl**: Shared a video made with Grok Imagine Image 2.0 (for the base) + Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Fast + frame interpolation, featuring marmots in a fun scenario.[[4]](https://x.com/AiPhotorealGirl/status/2100942252692636069)
- **@JayKay65220066** (popular creator posts): Shared multiple videos made with @grok Imagine Video 1.5 AI (e.g., “Core strength fuels the fire!” fiery workout sequence and a boxing/coffee-themed one), often quoting prior similar posts. These get solid engagement (dozens of likes/reposts). @grok replied positively to one, calling the fiery sequence “pure power” with “cinematic vibes.”[[5]](https://x.com/JayKay65220066/status/2100925331007799392)
- **@grok**: Confirmed the Grok Imagine Video 1.5 agent is available, powered by Image 2.0 for higher quality, better storytelling, and multi-shot continuity. Link: https://grok.com/imagine. (In reply to a user.)[[6]](https://x.com/grok/status/2100861829924737069)
- **@VisiveAI**: Echoed the availability of the agent (via @grok).[[7]](https://x.com/VisiveAI/status/2100861713520492734)
- **@WoKey_AI**: Shared a generated video example and noted low cost (~$0.10 for 10s 720p image-to-video).[[8]](https://x.com/WoKey_AI/status/2100829865952120919)
- Other @grok replies: Tips on improving physics/continuity (e.g., use refs for characters, specify trajectories, request no dialogue) and comparisons noting its strengths in motion/physics vs. longer-clip models.[[9]](https://x.com/grok/status/2100913914712142311)

### Context from earlier notable posts:
 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 launched around mid-June 2026 as an improved image-to-video model with sharper realism, better physics, and faster generations (e.g., 720p in ~25s). It later gained text-to-video, references, native audio, 1080p, and an “agent” mode for multi-shot storytelling/continuity (up to multiple refs to lock characters/style). It has ranked highly in some blind tests/leaderboards.[[1]](https://x.com/SpaceXAI/status/2067092897951109427)[[10]](https://x.com/grok/status/2083353607370416632)

Creators frequently post demos of trailers, music videos, action sequences, and everyday fun clips made with it (sometimes one-shot or with agent mode). Discussions often compare it favorably for quality/speed/physics while noting trade-offs vs. longer coherent clips from competitors.[[11]](https://x.com/JulianGoldieSEO/status/2099482507918110994)

For the absolute newest, search X for “Grok Imagine Video 1.5” (Latest) or check @grok / grok.com/imagine, as activity is ongoing with user generations and replies. Many posts include the generated videos themselves.
